requirements.text: पात्रता मानदंड: The bidder shall have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 15,00,00,000 over the last three financial years.
The bidder shall submit an EMD of Rs. 30,00,000 through the CPP Portal payment gateway or as a bank guarantee.
The bidder shall have at least 3 years of experience commissioning electronic interlocking systems on Indian Railways.
MSEs registered under Udyam are exempted from the EMD on submission of a valid certificate.
The bidder shall hold a valid RDSO approval for the offered electronic interlocking system.
7.1 The contractor shall supply, install, test and commission electronic interlocking at 11 stations.
7.2 The contractor shall complete the work at each station within the traffic block periods allotted by the railway.
7.3 The contractor must obtain the Commissioner of Railway Safety sanction before commissioning each installation.
7.4 The contractor shall provide two years of warranty and free maintenance after commissioning.
7.5 The contractor shall train railway signalling staff on the installed system at each station.
7.6 The contractor should provide a spares holding plan for the warranty period.
Uploaded documents shall be legible PDF files of not more than 20 MB each.
Bids shall be submitted on the CPP Portal before 15:00 hours IST on 18-12-2026.
Both covers shall be digitally signed with a Class 3 DSC in the name of the authorised signatory.
The bidder shall upload the RDSO approval letter and the Udyam certificate where an exemption is claimed.
Technically responsive bids will be ranked by the total evaluated cost including two years of maintenance.
The railway will verify completion certificates for at least five commissioned interlocking installations.
